Metadata.Title: RHSA-2026:99135: kernel security, bug fix, and enhancement update (Moderate)
Metadata.Description:
The kernel packages contain the Linux kernel, the core of any Linux operating system.

Security Fix(es):

* kernel: USB: serial: io_ti: fix heap overflow in get_manuf_info() (CVE-2026-53196)

* kernel: net/iucv: fix use-after-free of a severed iucv_path (CVE-2026-68140)

* kernel: sctp: avoid auth_enable sysctl UAF during netns teardown (CVE-2026-68162)

* kernel: s390/zcrypt: Validate length for CCA AES cipher key requests (CVE-2026-68452)

* kernel: s390/zcrypt: Validate length for CCA ECC private key requests (CVE-2026-68451)

* kernel: sunrpc: pin svc_xprt across the asynchronous TLS handshake callback (CVE-2026-72222)

* kernel: sunrpc: wait for in-flight TLS handshake callback when cancel loses race (CVE-2026-72221)

* kernel: nvmet-tcp: check return value of nvmet_tcp_set_queue_sock (CVE-2026-74385)

* kernel: sctp: keep chunk->transport in step with the list it is queued on (CVE-2026-74588)

* kernel: sctp: clear new_transport when removing a peer (CVE-2026-74586)

* kernel: sctp: validate cookie AUTH state before use (CVE-2026-74752)

* kernel: mptcp: options: reset DSS fields in case of unexpected size (CVE-2026-80586)

* kernel: s390/vfio_ccw: Cancel existing workqueues (CVE-2026-80553)

* kernel: powerpc/pseries: papr-phy-attest - validate cmd.length, plug mem leak (CVE-2026-80571)

* kernel: s390/qeth: validate user buffer length in SNMP and ARP query ioctls (CVE-2026-80584)

* kernel: ipv6: fix use-after-free in ip6_finish_output2() (CVE-2026-80792)

* kernel: net/smc: fix use-after-free of the LLC qentry in smc_llc_srv_add_link() (CVE-2026-80981)

* kernel: smb: client: fix OOB read/write from unvalidated DataOffset in coalesce_t2() (CVE-2026-89633)

* kernel: sctp: stop processing a packet once its association is deleted (CVE-2026-89479)

* kernel: s390/vfio-ap: Fix missing lock required to access list of ap_matrix_mdev objects (CVE-2026-89956)

* kernel: ALSA: seq: midi: Serialize input teardown with event_input (CVE-2026-90207)

* kernel: ALSA: pcm: Serialize PCM mmap with buffer reallocation to fix page UAF (CVE-2026-98116)

* kernel: smb: client: validate absolute native symlink targets before NT fixups (CVE-2026-98318)

* kernel: ipv4: validate checksum_start before completing checksum (CVE-2026-99999)

* kernel: net/sched: act_ct: fix helper UAF due to extensions realloc (CVE-2026-98442)

* kernel: ALSA: ua101: reject mismatched capture/playback packet sizes (CVE-2026-98741)

* kernel: net/smc: protect clcsock lifetime in smc_getname (CVE-2026-99032)

* kernel: kernel: Denial of Service via unvalidated task in iSCSI management responses (CVE-2026-99152)

* kernel: kernel: Denial of service via unvalidated task tag in iSCSI Reject PDU (CVE-2026-99153)

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* [RHEL9.9z] watchdog: System panics during reboot when pretimeout is disabled (0) (JIRA:RHEL-255218)

* RT scheduler livelock: migrate-disabled task at pushable-list head causes repeated RT push/stopper retries, starving a critical RT task (remaining issue after CVE-2026-45919 fix in 94894c9c477e) [rhel-9.9.z] (JIRA:RHEL-256280)

* MADVISE i/o size in RHEL 9 additionally limited by read_ahead_kb - Was addressed in RHEL8 via RHEL-22476 [rhel-9.9.z] (JIRA:RHEL-259532)

* try_charge_memcg() refactor in kernel 5.14.0-687.36.1 causes premature memcg OOM with GiB of clean page cache present [rhel-9.9.z] (JIRA:RHEL-269061)

* RHEL9.4 - kernel: CPU hotplug unsupported by CPUMF [rhel-9.9.z] (JIRA:RHEL-270893)

* Accel-DSA: dmaengine: idxd: kernel oops on unbind [rhel-9.9.z] (JIRA:RHEL-274411)

* af_unix: Fix peek then tail dereference UAF in unix_stream_data_wait() [rhel-9.9] (JIRA:RHEL-275410)

* Kernel panic after stopping retis capture  [rhel-9.9.z] (JIRA:RHEL-275457)

* Hard lockup experienced with repro from RHEL-282072 [rhel-9.9.z] (JIRA:RHEL-290031)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
